title: Mt Eliza Farmers Market
summary: VFMA-accredited farmers market on the Mount Eliza Village Green and Mt Eliza Way service road. The organiser lists 25 October and 22 November 2026, 9am–1pm..
streetAddress: Corner Mt Eliza Way and Canadian Bay Road
recurrenceNote: Fourth Sunday October through November 2026, 9am to 1pm.
accessibilityNotes: Access details have not been confirmed with the organiser.
weatherDependency: Outdoor; organiser says the market runs rain, hail or shine.
provenance: The organiser's 2026 market dates and About page were checked on 2026-10-03. They list 25 October and 22 November, 09:00–13:00, and an entry charge supporting Mt Eliza Rotary and Lions. The organiser says rain, hail or shine. The monthly daytime rule is bounded to those two dates because 18 December is a separately scheduled twilight market with different hours. The old 2026-06-24 start date was a Wednesday and the old free-entry claim contradicted the organiser.
nearbyAttractions: Mount Eliza Village cafes; Mt Eliza beach

heroImage.alt: Farmers market stalls on the Mornington Peninsula - Mt Eliza Farmers Market

editorVerdict: A VFMA-accredited village market with local growers and specialty makers, supported by the Mt Eliza Chamber of Commerce.
editorNote:
The organiser lists 25 October and 22 November 2026 as 9am–1pm markets. The 18 December twilight market has a separate schedule, so check the organiser's page before planning around that date.

Browse the growers and makers, then stop for brunch in Mt Eliza village.
